statement: Let ϵ > 0, and let v1, . . . , vm be independent random vectors with finite support in ℂd. If (A.1) m ∑ i=1 𝔼[viv∗ i ] = Id, 𝔼‖vi‖2 ≤ ϵ (1 ≤ i ≤ m), THE STRONG THIN TREE CONJECTURE 15 then (A.2) ℙ {‖ ‖ ‖ ‖ ‖ m ∑ i=1 viv∗ i ‖ ‖ ‖ ‖ ‖ ≤ (1 + √ ϵ)2 } > 0. Here ∗ denotes conjugate transpose and the norm is the operator norm. In particular, some outcome satisfies the corresponding positive-semidefinite upper bound. Real vectors are a special case.
